'''Garit''' was an individual who served as a member of the [[Believers]], a [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] that was based in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].

{{RPG|''[[Metatheran Caution: Belly of the Beaast|Belly of the Beaast]]''}}
Garit was part of a group of Believers who were sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caarimon]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], to place some transmitters on fault lines on the surface of the world, as part of a plot to release a virus that was [[Death/Legends|fatal]] to the [[Caarite]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Along with the Believers [[Imber]], [[Urna]] and [[Willus]], Garit attacked the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents who were investigating the plot.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Garit was created by [[Morrie Mullins (real person)|Morrie Mullins]] and appeared in the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-playing]] supplement ''[[Metatheran Caution: Belly of the Beaast|Belly of the Beaast]]''. During the adventure, the players [[Roleplaying game|role-play]] as the [[Heroes of Cularin]] and the number of Believers that attack the player characters on Caarimon varies, depending upon the role-playing tier of the player characters. Garit is only present if the player characters are ranked at an upper tier level. The scenario does not identify Garit's [[Gender/Legends|gender]] or [[Species/Legends|species]].
